name: Emissions selection — implausible supplier figure downgraded to the default
why: A supplier value more than ten times the Annex VI default is treated as a data error rather than a measurement, and the engine falls back to the default. This is the guard that stops a misplaced decimal point in a supplier return becoming a declared emissions figure, and it is exactly the kind of threshold a refactor can move without anyone noticing.
